hero.title: Axopar 29 CCX
hero.heading: Axopar 29 CCX – Performance Center Console Boat for Adventures
hero.intro: The Axopar 29 CCX now caters to a wide range of boating enthusiasts, from seasoned adventurers to first-time boaters, with complete freedom to choose between going ‘full-on’ fishing or selecting between several of the most sociable layouts out there.

sections.title: Extended Range
sections.intro: A 158-gallon fuel tank (600 litres) provides up to 300+ nautical miles of range, ensuring more than sufficient capacity for both inshore and offshore adventures. This represents a massive 100 percent increase in both range and capacity compared to the Axopar 28.

sections.title: Modularity Expressed Through Different Aft Deck Layouts
sections.intro: Why compromise when you don’t have to? The Axopar 29 CCX is designed to be fully customizable, offering several aft-deck configurations to suit a variety of functional preferences and requirements. This modularity and multifunctionality, which have been at the core of Axopar's success from the beginning, are now available for a center console boat.

sections.title: Integrating Sustainable Practices Into Design
sections.intro: Axopar boats are built for maximum efficiency and performance, making them lighter, faster and more sustainable. Our boats are constructed with up to 35-40 % less material than many traditional boats in their segments, using even up to 50 % less fuel and harnessing power more efficiently achieving speeds that many competitor boats require more power to reach. The hull of the Axopar 29 represents its third evolution since the original Axopar 28 was launched a decade ago. Hydrodynamic improvements have made it one of the most responsive, fuel-efficient, and best-handling hulls in its class today.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

sections.title: Alternatives for Aft Deck
sections.intro: The modular nature of Axopars and our multi-platform approach enable you to customize your boat with an aft layout that suits your everyday needs. As standard, the Axopar 29 XC Cross Cabin comes with a spacious open aft deck. The aft deck can also be equipped with an optional Aft Deck Bench, Main Baitwell, U-Sofa, Wet Bar, or Aft Cabin / Multi Storage Compartment.

items.name: Multi-cabin
items.title: Multi-cabin
items.text: The Multi-cabin serves as a large storage compartment as standard, and if you wish, you can further equip the space with an optional toilet and sink and/or additional mattresses to enable overnighting for two persons for those who do not wish to take away any space from the functional aft deck.

items.name: Driving Experience
items.title: Driving Experience
items.text: While delivering an unmatched driving experience, Axopar boats are known for their superior handling and performance, ensuring every ride is smooth, exhilarating, and enjoyable, whether on calm inland waters or navigating open seas.

items.name: Roof Modularity
items.title: Roof Modularity
items.text: The hardtop also includes a foldable 360° anchor light and preparations for telescopic outriggers, one on each side. A 100 W solar panel provides a practical solution for trickle charging the boat’s battery systems when shore power is unavailable. The hardtop can also be equipped with radar, searchlight, rod holder bar, and spray hood to better cover the sides of the helm.

items.name: Fenderbox Wet Bar
items.title: Fenderbox Wet Bar
items.text: The fender box wet bar comes with a top-loading refrigerator and a sink with a freshwater tap, both covered by wooden bamboo lids that can also be used as cutting boards. The optional Burnewiin mount enables you to add a grill, for example, near the Fenderbox Wet bar. This very convenient option can be combined with all aft-deck configurations.

items.name: Light in the Dark
items.title: Light in the Dark
items.text: The hardtop allows for the addition of a forward-facing 10000+ lumens light bar for low-light conditions. The CCX can also be specified with downward-facing flood lights directed onto the fore and aft decks. Together, these lights form the work lights option.

items.name: Involve All Senses
items.title: Involve All Senses
items.text: Exclusively for the 29 CCX, we are introducing an even more enhanced sound experience with an upgraded JL Audio Premium Sound system, which delivers superior sound quality on the water. Eight 6,5” speakers providing 480 W, powered by a 8 channel 800 W amplifier, two tweeters at the helm and a 10” 250 W subwoofer, guarantee a more powerful music experience.

items.name: Fenderbox Livewell
items.title: Fenderbox Livewell
items.text: Turn the starboard fenderbox into a dedicated livewell that keeps baitfish healthy and active by continuously circulating fresh seawater. This upgrade is ideal for owners who enjoy fishing and want a clean, integrated solution without losing deck space.

items.name: Fishbox with Macerator
items.title: Fishbox with Macerator
items.text: Conveniently integrated into the optional bow U-sofa extension, this insulated storage compartment holds up to 74 liters (19 gallons) of bait or catch. The integrated macerator pump and overboard drainage system allow quick flushing and hassle-free water removal, while the insulated construction helps keep temperatures cooler longer on extended trips.

sections.title: Configurations & Layouts
sections.intro: We want to provide you with an extensively customizable, user-friendly boat that meets your everyday needs year-round and supports all your adventures. The configuration you choose will define the final layout of your boat. Below are a few examples of exterior and interior layouts available.

items.title: Standard Open Aft
items.text: With optional Aft Leaning Post and U-Sofa with Silvertex Baltic.

items.title: Aft Deck Bench
items.text: With optional Fore Deck U-Sofa with Forward Facing Sun Lounge and optional Silvertex Sandstone Upholstery.

items.title: Wet Bar
items.text: With optional U-Sofa and standard Silvertex Petrol Upholstery.

items.title: Main Baitwell
items.text: With optional Aft Leaning Post, Fenderbox Livewell, U-Sofa with Sunbed Cushions, and optional Silvertex Cobre.

items.title: U-Sofa
items.text: With optional Fenderbox Wet Bar, U-Sofa with Optional Linetex Sphere Upholstery.

items.title: Aft Cabin
items.text: With L-Sofa and table, with optional Linetex Dust.

items.caption: A more athletic appearance, with raised bulwarks, enhances offshore capability and safety while moving around the deck, even during intense fishing sessions. The integrated handrails help prevent fishing lines from snagging, and the optional coaming pads offer increased comfort.

The console features a forward-tilting, fully enclosed, toughened glass windshield and side windows, offering excellent protection from wind chill, spray, and rain, reducing glare and displacing rain and spray very effectively, so wipers are rarely needed.

The forward-extending hardtop contributes to the boat’s modern look, offering better sun protection and when needed, airflow for the driver through its integrated skylight located in front of the helm.

The familiar foredeck from the 29-range is carried over, seating up to eight people around an optional U-sofa extension and hi-lo table, which can be converted into a sunbed. Additionally, a fish box option is available on the CCX fore deck.
Together with a large, foldable table, the U-sofa option creates an immersive, sociable, multi seating arrangement around the cockpit.

items.title: BRABUS Line Color Edition
modal_text: For style-conscious customers looking to make their Axopar 29 truly stand out, the Brabus Line Color Edition introduces four striking hull colors: the vibrant, playful Miami Blue; the more subtle, sophisticated Platinum Grey. The fresh, contemporary Glacier Blue; and the timeless, elegant Pearl White. These duo-tone color options combine colored areas with uncolored sections in a standard white finish, giving the boat a dynamic and distinctive look.

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: The BRABUS Performance Line features stylish hull and roof graphics and an extra boost of power on the transom, courtesy of Twin Mercury Verado V8 250hp DTS engines, to get you to your adventure destination promptly.

items.title: Fishability Options
modal_text:
Main bait well with tackle station right behind helm seats (33 gallons/125 liters)

Foldable aft leaning post with 6 rod holders and a Burnewiin GM400 mount. A wider folding sofa at the aft deck

Livewell with overboard drainage in port fenderbox (18.5 gallons/ 70 liters)

Fish box incl. macerator (19 gallons/74 liters) with overboard drainage in the bow U-sofa extension

Top-loading refrigerator for food storage

Four gunwale rod holders come as standard, with the possibility to have 16 rod holders in total throughout the boat

Gyro stabilizer preparation

Trolling motor preparation

Gunwale side bolsters

Echo sounder 1kW, thru-hull, SS175HW, wide beam, high chirp (150 to 250kHz)

Twin chart plotter option

Solar panel trickle charger system 100 W

Sea chest for live wells and raw water wash-down pump

Work lights

Rod holder bar on hardtop

Reinforced roof structure to accommodate for outriggers.

items.title: The Mediterrana Edition
modal_text:
Designed for those who enjoy lounging, socializing, or cruising in the sun, the Mediterrana Edition enhances onboard comfort and sophistication without compromising functionality. Luxurious features include thicker, plush, more refined cushions in a sophisticated beige tone. The upholstery’s structured texture and patterns not only exude style but also keep lounging areas cool and comfortable, even on the sunniest days.

Elegant bamboo trays and cup holders, along with warm-toned interior finishes, create an inviting, cozy atmosphere. Beige fabric wall panels and bamboo technical panels further enhance the sophisticated look and feel of the lounging areas.

technical_specifications.name: Hull design
technical_specifications.value: Twin stepped 22 degree V "Sharp entry hull"

standard_equipment.name: Wheelhouse / Cockpit
standard_equipment.description:
- Centered console with side windows and negative windshield.
- Stiff laminated roof with reinforcements for outriggers.
- Seating area with 6 seats in Silvertex Petrol.
- Pilot and co-pilot seats with flip-up bolsters on ​​​rotating and sliding swivels.
- Storage compartment under aft seats.
- 4x recessed LED roof lights.
- Harbor covers for seats and console.
- Integrated windscreen wipers and washer with separate reservoir.
- Openable skylight in helm for air circulation.
- Foldable anchor light and horn on roof.
- Clean helm layout with control switch panel in glass with illuminated buttons.
- Steering wheel in leather with Axopar logo.
- USB outlet in helm.

standard_equipment.name: General
standard_equipment.description:
- Higher bulwarks compared to the rest of the range.
- Hand laminated, twin-stepped hull in Vinyl ester resin for the first coat for osmosis prevention.
- Stiffer and more rigid construction compared to previous models
- Reduced weight by optimized glass fiber layup.
- All PVC sandwich material is replaced by PET recycled materials
- No plywood used for constructural purposes.
- Hull design with “sharp entry bow” and integrated engine brackets.
- Sound insulated hull.
- Grey rub rail with rubber end caps.
- Axopar 3D signature chrome logo on both sides of hull.
- Bow thruster tunnel preparation.
- LED navigation lights.
- Anchor box in bow.
- Walk-around deck layout with open aft deck
- Anti-skid finishing on self-draining working deck.
- L-sofa bench in bow area with storage space underneath.
- All pulpits, side rails, locks, hinges, filler caps & cockpit grab rails in 316 stainless steel
- 6x cleats around deck.
- Hooking points for safety harness around side deck areas
- Pulpits on fore deck.
- Twin large fender storages on aft deck
- Battery / electrical compartment under aft deck storage.
- Flagpole.
- Fixed 600l fuel tank with level sensor.
- 2x electric auto bilge pumps and 2x manual bilge pumps.

standard_equipment.name: Front Cabin
standard_equipment.description:
- Storage space with skylight and mirror.
- Main fuse panel with automatic fuses.
- 12V USB outlet.
- Fire and CO alarms.
- 2x roof spotlights.
- Ventilation grilles.
